name: Retrieval Token Cutter
description: Local code search and exact-replacement edit tools backed by Retrieval Token Cutter.

rtc_read.description: Read file contents. For code tasks, use only when rtc_search_code misses the needed exact text after a focused retry.

rtc_search_code.description: Search source, tests, docs, and release notes. content_excerpt is exact editable file text for edit replacement context; do not re-read files already returned with usable snippets.

rtc_edit_file.description: Edit source/doc files through exact replacement. Build old_string from exact RTC search snippets; if exact text is still missing after search retry, use a narrow read.

rtc_index_codebase.description: Warm or report workspace indexing state.

rtc_health.description: Check local Retrieval Token Cutter backend health.

repoRoot.description: Path to the Retrieval Token Cutter repository. Auto-detected when omitted.

workspaceRoot.description: Default workspace root for code search/edit. Defaults to RTC_WORKSPACE_ROOT or OpenClaw's current working directory.

runtimeDir.description: Runtime directory for local RTC/AGFS processes. Defaults to ~/.cache/retrieval-token-cutter-openclaw-plugin.

autoStart.description: Start RTC/AGFS when OpenClaw loads the plugin if the backend is not already healthy.

autoStop.description: Stop services started by this plugin when OpenClaw unloads it.

startWaitSeconds.description: Seconds to wait for RTC backend health during startup.

injectCodePolicy.description: Inject RTC code-search/edit policy into code-like prompts.

readToolPolicy.description: Controls the RTC read replacement. advisory exposes rtc_read; guard exposes rtc_read and blocks native read.

accountId.description: RTC account id for backend requests. Defaults to RTC_ACCOUNT_ID or acct-demo.

userId.description: RTC user id for backend requests. Defaults to RTC_USER_ID or u-openclaw.

agentId.description: RTC agent id for backend requests. Defaults to RTC_AGENT_ID or openclaw.

sessionId.description: Optional RTC session id for backend requests.
